messages:
maria: raising a proposal — add optional `ttl` and `audience_granularity` to runtime flags so teams can do short-lived tweaks and staged ramps (1% -> 100%) by cohort. need API + console + telemetry alignment before flip.

Tom: +1 on TTL. semantics question: when TTL expires, should override auto-delete or revert to previous value? prefer revert for audit trail.

anil: revert too. TTL expiry should emit tombstone event and create new config version restoring prior value.

jen: UI note: console should show "active until" with quick extend/stop. show attached telemetry rule if any.

maria: API sketch:

```
POST /runtime/configs
{
  "key": "routing.model_choice",
  "value": { "model": "redwood-fast-v2", "weight": 10 },
  "audience_granularity": "cohort",
  "cohort_id": "alpha-2026-04",
  "percent": 1,
  "ttl": "30m",
  "created_by": "maria"
}
```

maria: q's: 1) typed schema/coercion for existing flags? 2) how to count percent when <100? 3) telemetry gating: who wires alerts to auto-stop?

Tom: (1) runtime must validate against typed defs in config-service. coercion is risky; reject incompatible writes.

anil: (2) sample at router (probabilistic) vs materialized cohorts (deterministic). sampling is cheap but hard to audit; materialized cohorts increase bookkeeping and affect quota calcs.

jen: telemetry gating: allow attaching a "traffic-watch" rule that monitors P99/error-rate and triggers rollback. console shows rule and last eval.

Deploy-bot: rollout/2165432100 created by maria — 1% -> 100% plan (cohort: alpha-2026-04) TTL=30m

anil: billing: router must tag backend requests with config_version and cohort_id so billing/telemetry attribute actual tokens to correct config.

Tom: add headers `X-Config-Version` and `X-Cohort-Id` to model backend requests and traces.

maria: audit requirement: config-service emits immutable events on create/expire/rollback with diffs; console diff view required.

jen: UI flow: draft rollout modal with preview of impacted routes, estimated cost delta (last 7d sample), checkbox to attach auto-rollback, owner+secondary approver required for >=50% in prod.

anil: TTLs should not auto-extend on re-apply; explicit extend API only. overlapping rollouts for same key+cohort -> reject or queue, never merge silently.

maria: default assignment: deterministic hash by user_id when present, else request_id. reproducible and debuggable.

Tom: provide `assignment_seed` param for stable sharding across keys.

jen: telemetry: add metric dimension `rollout_version` and `cohort_id`; alerts on cost-per-token/latency per rollout_version.

anil: add dry-run=true to POST so teams can preview routing decisions for sampled traffic. expose as "preview" in console.

maria: stop/rollback API sketch:

```
POST /runtime/configs/{id}/stop
{
  "reason": "error_rate_spike",
  "initiated_by": "ops-oncall"
}
```

ops-bot: telemetry rule triggered: config/2165432100 auto-stopped — error_rate > 1.5% for 3m. rollback event created: 2165432700

Tom: what if cohort spikes and exhausts reserved GPU capacity? fail closed or fallback?

anil: fallback pluggable per-rollout. default fallback -> cheaper compatible model + emit `fallback_invoked` events. fail closed only for safety-critical flows.

jen: console must let teams pick fallback and show downstream impact in preview (latency/cost/quality).

maria: next steps: RFC items: typed schema + validation, router hashing + header tagging, TTL lifecycle + immutable events, console rollout modal + preview + dry-run, telemetry auto-rollback wiring.

maria: can @anil + @jen own 1 & 4? @tom owns 2 & 3? i'll draft RFC and include API samples.

anil: taking 1 & 4. will add cohort materialization task to infra backlog.

jen: taking 4. will coordinate with design on preview and cost estimator.

Tom: taking 2 & 3. will implement header tagging and TTL revert semantics in runtime sprint.

maria: thanks all, leaving thread for blockers. :thumbsup:
